contract_question: Screening the 1789 local-delta escape-route closers for pin-stable statements -> >=10 genuine Tier-2 rows -> independent prover -> bundle_run through canonical v4.29.0: does it hit the Tier-2 gate (>=2 clean non-control closures OR >=5 exact-gaps/falsifiers, 0 false-ratify, 0 wrong-kind)?
rationale_short: Large candidate pool makes a pass plausible, but the gate is brittle: clean non-control closures and exact-gap/falsifier counts can get derailed by row typing, wrong-kind contamination, or resolver/bundle drift before the underlying screening quality is decisive.
